data: Do the orange boxes represent output from the context encoder?

The orange boxes in Figure 1 represent the outputs of the context encoder. They are shown as part of the target post \( x_t \), which is processed by the Keyphrase Tagger. The context encoder processes the conversation context \( x_c^t \) and produces an output \( e_i^c \). This output is then passed to the Keyphrase Tagger through the orange boxes. Therefore, the orange boxes do indeed represent output from the context encoder.
